thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 for streaming endpoint /v1/stream (eu-west-1) exceeded 5s — possible SSE/WebSocket stalls. Paging oncall.

alex_sre: On it, joining. Seeing spike in p95/p99 since ~09:11 UTC. Escalating to runtime.

jen_runtime: I can see proxy write backpressure rising on stream-proxy-12, connections piling up. Logs show repeated EAGAIN during write.

jen_runtime: snippet:
```
proxy_conn.write_backpressure=0.92
upstream_write_errors=47
sse_chunk_queue_len=1200
```

miguel_platform: Any config pushes around 09:10? I rolled out a minor connection tuning at 09:08 to reduce buffer sizes (nginx upstream_buf 8k -> 4k), could be related.

elaine_support: Support reports 4 tickets in EU region with stuck live responses — customers seeing empty stream frames until timeout.

alex_sre: Ok, mitigation plan: 1) enable evict-slow-clients feature on stream-proxy; 2) temporarily increase upstream buffer to previous size; 3) route ~10% of traffic to fallback variant without chunked framing.

jen_runtime: Commands I'm running now:
```
redwoodctl feature enable evict-slow-clients --target stream-proxy-*
redwoodctl config set stream-proxy upstream_buf=8192 --env eu-west-1
redwoodctl routes weight set /v1/stream --variant fallback --percent 10
```

alex_sre: @miguel can you rollback your tuning if needed? If reverting fixes p99 quickly we pin it.

miguel_platform: Rolling back nginx buf change on stream-proxy-12 and -13 now. Patch applied at 09:14 UTC.

jen_runtime: Eviction enabled and buffer increased. Observing p99 drop from ~5.2s -> ~0.9s within 60s. backpressure metric dropping.

elaine_support: Notified impacted customers A and B; created incident JIRA INC-4587 linking this thread.

sam_sales: FYI customers on trial were affected but support already reached out, putting customer-facing note on status page.

jen_runtime: Also toggled a short keepalive bump to 30s and lowered max-chunks-in-flight to 50 as a protective measure.

alex_sre: Good work. Monitoring for 15m. If stable we'll keep changes and schedule postmortem. Can someone capture trace from a stuck connection for root cause? Prefer a raw tcp dump from proxy-12.

jen_runtime: Capturing tcpdump now, saving to s3://incidents/5178902468/proxy12.pcap

miguel_platform: Confirmed rollback correlates with p99 improvement — suspect buffer reduction caused small writes and increased system calls leading to backpressure with slow clients.

alex_sre: Status update: mitigation success, p99 ~850ms, p95 ~120ms. No new customer escalations reported. last message: 09:16 UTC.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigation applied — watching. Pager cleared. Postmortem scheduled for tomorrow 16:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
